name: a-red-suite-is-not-recorded-past-its-own-guard
breaks: the recorder's tolerance widens from the files holding the record's own guards to every failure in the suite, so a run in which real tests died half way through is written down as the measurement: the files that failed contributed only the cost of what they got through, and the fast run's floor is then chosen from a distribution that came from a broken run (#837)
